CCP_action_opinion_up_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = ROOT.ccp_target_country
		}
		var:ROOT.ccp_target_country = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = ccp_goodwill }
		}
		set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 11 }
		set_variable = { ccp_last_action = 202 }
		CCP_history_record = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.ccp_status = 22 }
	}
	CCP_mark_dirty = yes
}
